The supplied PoC constructs A2MP association-response traffic on AMP_MGR_CID and transmits it as fragmented ACL data.

impact.affected_asset: Linux kernel Bluetooth receive workqueue and kernel memory/object interpretation.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause type-confused kernel object interpretation through A2MP/L2CAP protocol traffic within Bluetooth radio range; standalone RCE is not established for CVE-2020-12351 by this record.
impact.security_effect: Remote unauthenticated Bluetooth packet processing can trigger a kernel general-protection fault; in the documented multi-vulnerability chain it supplies a type-confusion primitive used alongside a separate information leak and heap-control work.

causal_trace.summary: A remote peer supplies crafted Bluetooth ACL/L2CAP A2MP traffic; the PoC forms A2MP association responses for the AMP manager channel and sends them over ACL data.
A2MP manager creation stores a struct amp_mgr in chan->data, but the ERTM/streaming receive path subsequently supplies chan->data to sk_filter, which expects a struct sock.
l2cap_data_rcv invokes sk_filter on the type-confused channel data; the documented failure is a general-protection fault in sk_filter_trim_cap, reached through L2CAP receive processing.

The documented immediate result is a Bluetooth workqueue kernel crash. The writeup separately describes an RCE chain requiring BadChoice and heap-control dependencies, so standalone code execution is not attributed to this type confusion alone.

failure.operation: sk_filter invocation and subsequent processing in sk_filter_trim_cap using chan->data as a struct sock

primary_invariant.statement: When the L2CAP receive path calls sk_filter(chan->data, skb), chan->data must designate an object compatible with struct sock.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The A2MP manager setup assigns a struct amp_mgr to chan->data, while ERTM/streaming receive processing treats that field as the struct sock argument required by sk_filter.

raw_refs.role: PoC execution and stated test environment

quality.review_notes: The primary mechanism and author-reported kernel call trace are documented in the writeup, and a concrete public PoC is supplied. No upstream patch diff, fixed-version validation, regression test, minimized testcase, sanitizer report, or independently captured run result is bundled. The record deliberately limits impact to the type-confusion crash/primitive and does not assign the writeup's multi-CVE RCE outcome to CVE-2020-12351 alone.

remediation.invariant_restored: Any value passed from chan->data to sk_filter must be a valid struct sock, or the A2MP receive design must avoid calling sk_filter with manager state stored in that field.
mitigation_classes: remove or correct the incompatible chan->data-to-sk_filter object flow
reduce Bluetooth High Speed attack surface by disabling the feature by default

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Linux kernel 4.8 (reported introduction; exact fixed range is not established in this bundle)
